subject.title: Bound batch file read with size cap in config-set-input

question: Should `openclaw config set --batch-file` adopt a fixed 8 MiB maximum that rejects previously accepted large batch inputs, and if so what supported operator contract should accompany it?
rationale: The bounded-read primitive is appropriate, but selecting a new public CLI input ceiling requires product and upgrade judgment rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Set and document a supported limit
options.body: Confirm an evidence-backed size ceiling, document the resulting failure mode, and require CLI-level boundary tests before merging.

options.title: Preserve broader batch compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded parsing or batching approach that avoids rejecting legitimate large existing batch files at a fixed 8 MiB threshold.

recommendation.title: Set and document a supported limit
recommendation.body: Confirm an evidence-backed size ceiling, document the resulting failure mode, and require CLI-level boundary tests before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline supplies the only direct reviewer-routing signal for the CLI compatibility decision.
